text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
Good morning. I've been waiting for you.
Now, hold this luggage for me!
We're heading out at once!
text_block_list.orig_text:
おはよう、
待ってたわ。
さ、
この荷物を持って！
すぐに出かけるわよ！

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
Where are we going, you ask?
Why, I'm happy you asked. We're going to dig for a hot spring!
text_block_list.orig_text:
どこへ行くのかって？
よくぞ聞いてくれたわね。
今から温泉を採掘するの！

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that face... You're thinking it's impossible, aren't you?
Don't worry—I've had mining experience in previous jobs,
so I have a flair for digging.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ。
その顔、
無理だって思ってるでしょ。
大丈夫よ、
炭鉱でのバイト経験だってあるし。
穴を掘るのは得意なの。

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
It came to me in a flash!
The final key to turning this into the ultimate resort...
We need to have a hot spring bath!
text_block_list.orig_text:
閃いたのよ！
　最高のリゾートのための最後の鍵……
それは、
温泉だって。

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
After a day of exertion at the beach, you can relax at the hot spring,
then enjoy a wonderful meal and a spa experience...
Doesn't that sound like the perfect day?
text_block_list.orig_text:
綺麗な海で思う存分遊んだあとは、
温泉であたたまって、
素敵な料理とエステで癒される……
完璧な流れだと思わない？

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
So I've decided! Unearthing a hot spring is our top priority!
Unless you have any questions, let's get moving!
text_block_list.orig_text:
とにかく、
温泉開発は最優先事項ってことなのよ。
分かってもらえたなら、
早速出発よ！

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
I looked into the geology of the region,
and this area seems like our best bet.
Now! Let's get to work!
text_block_list.orig_text:
地盤調査の情報を見た感じだと、
このあたりがよさそうね。
さあ！
　いくわよ～！

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
*pant*... *pant*... We've dug ourselves quite the hole,
but there's no sign of hot water to be found...
text_block_list.orig_text:
はぁ……
それなりに掘ったと思うんだけど、
全然出そうな気配がないわね。

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
Let's take a quick break.
We can't keep this up without some proper rest.
choice_data_list: Maybe we should rethink the hot spring idea.
This plan seems a little inefficient...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ちょっと休憩しましょうか。
さすがに休まないと、
もたないわよね。

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
Oh, no. A hot spring is an absolute must for the ultimate resort.
I'm not about to give up.
text_block_list.orig_text:
いいえ。
温泉は最高のリゾートづくりに絶対欠かせないものよ。
諦める気はないわ。

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
I wouldn't say that.
This is the shortest route to ensuring
the highest quality resort experience.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そんなことないわ。
これが、最高のリゾートを作るための
最短かつ
最高効率の行動よ。

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
I appreciate that you're trying to keep my expectations realistic,
but I'm afraid on this point, I'm not willing to back down.
text_block_list.orig_text:
{0}くんも考えたうえで、
色々言ってくれているんだと思うけど……
この件に関しては、
私も引くわけにはいかないの。

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text: Aahh! Wh-what?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ひゃっ……
な、なにっ！？

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text: Hey! Where are you suddenly dragging me off to?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ちょっと、
急に引っ張って
どこに連れて行く気！？

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
To meet the chairman of that firm? But why?
Just so you're aware, I won't let anyone talk me out of this!
text_block_list.orig_text:
大商会の会長のところ？
　なんでそんなところに……
言っておくけど、
誰が何を言っても無駄よ？

text_block_list.name: Chairman
text_block_list.text:
Oh? If it ain't the pair who helped us with the Octoking.
Did you want something?
text_block_list.orig_text:
お？
　帝王ダコの時の小僧と嬢ちゃんじゃねぇか。
どうかしたのか？

text_block_list.name: Chairman
text_block_list.text:
H-hold on, now. What's this about, young man?
Why are you throwing yourself on the ground?
text_block_list.orig_text:
って、
おいおい。
なんだ小僧、
藪から棒に頭なんか下げちまって。

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
H-hold on!
{0}, you don't need to prostrate yourself for him!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ちょ、ちょっと！
なんで{0}くんがそんなことするのよ！？

text_block_list.name: Chairman
text_block_list.text:
What's that? You need our help unearthing a hot spring?
To make this young lady's \"ultimate resort\" a reality?
text_block_list.orig_text:
なに？
　一緒に温泉採掘をしてほしい？
嬢ちゃんが目指す最高のリゾートを作るために？

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text: Huh?
text_block_list.orig_text: え？

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
The \"ultimate resort\"...
He's really trying to achieve it for me?
text_block_list.orig_text:
最高のリゾート……
{0}くんも真剣に考えてくれているんだ。

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
Even begging for help from an old enemy,
all for the sake of making my crazy idea work...
text_block_list.orig_text:
敵対しかけた相手に頭を下げてまで、
温泉を掘ろうと言ってくれるなんてね……

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text: In that case, I can't let his efforts go to waste!
text_block_list.orig_text:
なら私も、
{0}くんの気持ちに応えないと！

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
Mr. Chairman, I humbly request your aid as well!
I want to create an ultimate resort that will be the pride of this region!
Lend me your strength!
text_block_list.orig_text:
会長さん、
私からもお願いしますっ！
　この海の自慢になるような、
最高のリゾートを作りたいのっ。
力を貸してっ！

text_block_list.name: Chairman
text_block_list.text: You too, young lady? Geez, I didn't ask for all this...
text_block_list.orig_text:
嬢ちゃんまで……
勘弁してくれよ、
ったく。

text_block_list.name: Chairman
text_block_list.text:
But still... the \"ultimate resort,\" eh? Quite the goal you've got there.
I've got to say... I like the sound of it.
It's a fine phrase that sets my heart a-beating.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……最高のリゾートねぇ。
大きく出たもんだ。
それにしても……
いい言葉だな。
心が躍る、
いい響きだ。

text_block_list.name: Chairman
text_block_list.text:
I've taken a liking to you, young lady.
Let's see if we can't make good on those words.
I want you to show me this ultimate resort of yours.
text_block_list.orig_text:
気に入ったぜ嬢ちゃん。
その言葉、
買わせてもらおう。
最高のリゾート、
見せてもらおうじゃねぇか。

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text: Th... thank you very much!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ……
ありがとうございます！

text_block_list.name: Chairman
text_block_list.text: So, how soon do we start work?
text_block_list.orig_text:
で、
いつから始めるつもりだ？

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text: Ehm... Actually, we already started.
text_block_list.orig_text:
えっと。
実はもう始めてるの。

text_block_list.name: Chairman
text_block_list.text: Oh? Where did you find yourself a workforce?
text_block_list.orig_text:
は？
　どうやって人手を集めたんだ？

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text: Ahaha... It's just me and him.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あはは……
私たち二人だけよ。

text_block_list.name: Chairman
text_block_list.text:
Just how unhinged can the two of you be?!
Hahah... I've got no words!
All right then, let's get down to it!
text_block_list.orig_text:
どんだけ無謀なことしやがるんだお前ら！？
はは、
かなわねぇな。
分かった、
早速始めるぞ！

text_block_list.name: Chairman
text_block_list.text:
Time to get to work! Are you with me, men?!
Let's dig up a great old geyser!
text_block_list.orig_text:
さあ作業開始だ！
　いくぞお前ら、
でっけぇ温泉掘り当てるぞ！

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
Incredible... We dug a hole this deep in next to no time...
I have to keep doing my part.
text_block_list.orig_text:
すごいわね、
あっという間に深い穴ができちゃった……
私も頑張らないと。

text_block_list.name: Chairman
text_block_list.text: Hey, young lady. Can I have a word while we both catch our breath?
text_block_list.orig_text:
おい、嬢ちゃん。
休憩がてらにちょっといいか？

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text: Why would that be?
text_block_list.orig_text: なにかしら？

text_block_list.name: Chairman
text_block_list.text:
That friend of yours... He's a fine young man.
Debasing yourself like that for someone else's sake
isn't something just anyone can do.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あんたの相棒、
いい奴じゃねぇか。
他人のために必死に頭下げるなんて、
なかなかできねぇもんだ。

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text: You're right.I'm proud to have him as my partner!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうね。
彼は私の……
最高のパートナーよ。

text_block_list.name: Chairman
text_block_list.text: Long as you know that, I hope you'll take good care of him.
text_block_list.orig_text:
分かってんなら、
せいぜい
大切にしてやんな。

text_block_list.name: Firm Employee
text_block_list.text: Chairman! Come over here a moment!
text_block_list.orig_text:
会長！
　ちょっと来てください！

text_block_list.name: Chairman
text_block_list.text: Yeah? What is it?
text_block_list.orig_text:
おお、
なんだ～っ？

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text: Of course. I'd have it no other way.
text_block_list.orig_text:
もちろん、
そのつもりよ。

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
Just as {0} has supported me at every turn,
I have to make sure I can support him.
text_block_list.orig_text:
{0}くんが私を支えてくれたように、
私も{0}くんを支えられるようにならないとね。

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
Ahhh?!
H-honestly, do you have to show up so suddenly?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ひゃっ！？
も、
もうっ、
いきなりなんだから{0}くんはっ。

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text: Anyway, what did you want?
text_block_list.orig_text:
それより、
なにかあったの？

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text: Huh? You hit a hard layer and can't dig any further?
text_block_list.orig_text:
え？
　固い地盤に当たってこれ以上掘り進められない？

text_block_list.name: Chairman
text_block_list.text: Well, ain't this a pickle...
text_block_list.orig_text: こりゃ参ったな……

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text: Chairman!
text_block_list.orig_text: 会長さん！

text_block_list.name: Chairman
text_block_list.text:
Ah, young lady. We've run into a snag.
This layer's so tough, we can't make a dent in it.
text_block_list.orig_text:
おぉ、
嬢ちゃん。
見ての通りだ。
この地盤、
これっぽっちも杭が通りやしねぇ。

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text: That sounds like a job for me!
text_block_list.orig_text: それなら、私にまかせて！

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text: Hey, {0}, will you lend me your strength?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ねえ{0}くん。
私に力を貸して？

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
Thank you. Ahhh...
Strength is flowing through every inch of my body.
This will do fine!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ありがとう。
あぁ……
身体の奥から力が溢れてくるわ。
これなら……！

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text: Hey—thank you again. For always believing in me.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ねえ、
ありがとうね。
私のこと、
信じてくれて。

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text: In return, I'll let you witness my maximum efficiency!
text_block_list.orig_text:
これから私の最高効率、
見せてあげるわ。

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
Here I go, then...
With all the power that you gave me!
text_block_list.orig_text:
じゃあ、いくわよ……
{0}くんのくれた、
この力で……！

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaaahhhhhhhhh!
text_block_list.orig_text: うおぉおおぉぉおおっおおぉおお！！

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text: Ahh! W-we did it! All riiiiight!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……！！
　
や、やった！
　やったああぁああ！！

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text: Look, look! We did it! We really did it!
text_block_list.orig_text:
見て見てっ！
　やったわ、
やったのよ私たちっ！！

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
It's really here! A real hot spring! Haha... Ahahaha!
It's a genuine natural hot spring! Can you feel that heat?! It's amazing!
text_block_list.orig_text:
出ちゃった！
　温泉出ちゃった！！
　ははっ、
あははは！
正真正銘の天然温泉よ！
　すごい熱気！
　すごいすごいっ！

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
It's so wet and warm...
Haha. I suppose I'm stating the blatantly obvious.
It is a hot spring, after all.
text_block_list.orig_text:
とってもあったかいわね……
ふふ、
私なに当たり前のこと言ってるんだろ、
温泉だものねっ。

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text: I just have to say... thank you!
text_block_list.orig_text:
私の方こそ、
ありがとう！

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
I couldn't have done it without you, {0}.
Really, this is all thanks to you!
I only managed to come this far because you were by my side.
text_block_list.orig_text:
{0}くんのおかげだよ……
全部、
{0}くんのおかげなんだから。
{0}くんがいてくれたから、
がんばれたんだよ。

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text: So honestly, thank you so much!
text_block_list.orig_text:
本当に、
ありがとう……！

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
Mifuyu treated {0} to a smile
that seemed to overflow with sheer joy.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ミフユは{0}に、
こぼれんばかりの笑顔を向けるのだった。
